ai_summary: BEML Land Assets Limited (BLAL) has announced the routine appointment of M/s Ranga & Co. as its statutory auditors for the Financial Year 2026-27, fulfilling SEBI disclosure requirements. This is a standard corporate governance update and signifies a typical operational activity for the Government of India company. There are no material financial impacts or apparent red flags associated with this appointment, given the firm's stated 36 years of experience.
